feeds.name: Law Enforcement Dispatched Calls for Service: Real-Time
feeds.window: dispatched calls that closed within 48 hours of retrieval
feeds.notLive: This is not live 911 and carries no audio. It is a published record of dispatched calls, and it is incomplete while calls are open.

feeds.name: 311 Cases
feeds.window: 311 cases opened in the last 7 days, capped at 400 per service type
feeds.notLive: The dataset is published nightly; a request may already be resolved or scheduled.

note: Both feeds are City of San Francisco open data (PDDL). Coordinates are snapped to about 40 m, street addresses and free-text details are not stored, and categories describing a person rather than a place are excluded before publication.
